name: hono
description_en: Web framework built on Web Standards
readme_excerpt: Hono - means flame🔥 in Japanese - is a small, simple, and ultrafast web framework built on Web Standards. It works on any JavaScript runtime: Cloudflare Workers, Fastly Compute, Deno, Bun, Vercel, AWS Lambda, Lambda@Edge, and Node.js. Fast, but not only fast. Quick Start Features - Ultrafast 🚀 - The router RegExpRouter is really fast. Not using linear loops. Fast. - Lightweight 🪶 - The hono/tiny preset is under 12kB. Hono has zero dependencies and uses only the Web Standard API. - Multi-runt…
